newsitem.title: UK: INTERVIEW-CE sought agreed bid for N.Electric.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-CE sought agreed bid for N.Electric.

text.p: CE Electric sought an agreed bid with its target Northern Electric but disagreed on price, said David Sokol chairman and chief executive of CalEnergy, which owns 70 percent of CE Electric.
"There was no opposition to the proposal (of a bid), the only area we could not agree on was value," he told Reuters in an interview.
CE Electric announced on Monday it was offering 630 pence a share for English regional electricity distributor Northern Electric, valuing the ordinary share capital at 651 million stg.
